lines.text: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and the elders anointed him king over Israel.
David reigned forty years, including twenty-five years over all Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.
David and his men marched against the Jebusites in Jerusalem, and David captured the fortress of Zion.
David lived in the fortress, and Hiram king of Damascus sent envoys and cedar logs to him.
After arriving from Hebron, David took more wives from Jerusalem, and sons including Solomon were born to him there.
